Every surface is swept along a lightness ladder anchored at the theme's own extreme, not taken from the ramp — steps taken from an eleven-step ramp collided in the light themes. Each is at least 0.9 CIEDE2000 from its neighbours, so the depth vocabulary is visibly distinct rather than nominally so.
